data.description:
DESIGN.md "Paste at cursor": the transcript stays on the clipboard on purpose today. Reading the old clipboard can trigger macOS 26's privacy prompt.

Design hand-off (11 October) asks for 'Keep what was on the clipboard'. Caution: on macOS 26, reading the clipboard can raise the paste-privacy prompt (DESIGN.md, around line 126); EasyVox never reads it today.
